shortDescription: Opens or closes remote support tunnel.

options.name: code
options.description: Code from support used to open remote support tunnel. Relevant only if C(state) is I(present).

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the remote support tunnel. If C(state) is I(absent) the remote support tunnel will be closed. If C(state) is I(present) the remote support tunnel will be opened.
